title: Recipes are great - when the app works
body: This app frequently crashes and it’s incredibly frustrating.

title: Love this app so easy!
body: What do I love about this app? I love how you can toggle between the ingredients and the directions. Super organized app, being OCD, I love that. You can create shopping list, pick holiday ideas, meal ideas, save recipes. Ever since Allrecipes app disappeared (sorry the website isnt the same) I have been lost. This is my new go to.

title: Not a good app
body: Basically all of the receipts i’ve done have not turned out good (not a skill issue). Half of the receipts are just jell-o shots witch are just not good. Don’t download this app, it’s not worth it

title: Ads and functions don’t work
body: All the titles instead of just the dish name are stupid clickbait titles, there’s ads frequently, and then when you click on the recipes you saved it won’t let you scroll through them so that feature is essentially useless

title: Glitchy
body: Keeps logging me out and saying my account doesn’t exist, when I’ve already paid for premium🙃

title: Favs doesn’t work
body: I just put about 70 recipes in my favorites and if I go to the favorites page, it doesn’t scroll so I can only see recipes. Also you should put an option to contact you in the app.

title: Money and food saver
body: The feature that lets you input what ingredients you already have in your fridge is incredible. I've cut down my food waste significantly and found some really creative ways to use up leftovers. Easily the best food app on my phone

title: Nice ideas, too many premium locks
body: It’s a nicely designed app with some great meal ideas, but almost every time I click on a recipe that looks really good, a paywall pops up. The free version is extremely limited. I understand developers need to make money, but it feels a bit too restrictive.

title: Perfect for beginners
body: I had zero cooking skills before downloading this app. The step-by-step instructions and short video clips make everything so easy to follow. I actually look forward to cooking dinner now instead of ordering takeout. Highly recommend for beginners!

title: Requesting family sharing
body: Love the recipe collections and the meal planner. It would be a solid 5 stars if I could share the premium account or sync the grocery list seamlessly with my spouse's phone

title: No more staring blankly at the fridge
body: Usually I stand in front of open fridge doors wondering what to make. This app turns random produce and half-used sauces into an actual dinner in seconds. Simple UI and highly practical

title: Great UI, too many notifications
body: Beautiful user interface and highly functional. However, the app sends way too many push notifications about premium upgrades. I had to turn them off entirely in my device settings.

title: Reporting battery drain
body: The content is fantastic and very helpful for my diet, but the app drains my battery incredibly fast when I leave the screen on while cooking. The performance needs some optimization.

title: Requesting family sharing
body: Love the recipe collections and the meal planner. It would be a solid 5 stars if I could share the premium account or sync the grocery list seamlessly with my spouse's phone.

title: Praising daily inspiration
body: This app has completely transformed my daily cooking routine. I used to cycle through the same three meals, but now I have endless inspiration. Everything is easy to follow and tastes great.

title: Nice Design
body: The design is gorgeous and very user-friendly. The meal plans are realistic and don't require crazy, hard-to-find ingredients. I just wish the app synced with Apple Health or my Apple Watch so my calorie intake and burned calories could be in one place.

title: Good family meals, scaling could be better
body: It’s hard to find a 'healthy eating' app that the whole family will actually eat, but the recipes here are definitely kid-approved. I just wish the portion scaling was smarter. When I change the servings from 2 to 4, it sometimes gives weird measurements like '1.34 onions'. Needs a bit of rounding adjustment!

title: Like app
body: It’s simple and easy to use, i don’t need too many feautures

title: Praising UI, critiquing the search feature
body: The app interface is nice, and the food pictures make me want to jump into the kitchen right away. I’ve learned a lot of quick dinner recipes here. However, the search function isn’t fully optimized. If misspell a word slightly or use general keywords, nothing shows up. I hope the developers improve the search filters to be a bit smarter
